title: Notice of Consent Decree in The Daily Wire, LLC, et al. v. U.S. Department of State Litigation
detail_text: Notice of Consent Decree in The Daily Wire, LLC, et al. v. U.S. Department of State Litigation On April 08, 2026, the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Texas, Tyler Division entered a consent decree in The Daily Wire, LLC, et al. v. U.S. Department of State litigation. This notice complies with the requirement to apprise all Department employees, contractors, grantees, of the consent decree. Additional information about the consent decree can be found below. Order on Motion to Approve Consent Judgment – #131 in The Daily Wire, LLC v. United States Department of State (E.D. Tex., 6:23-cv-00609) – CourtListener.com
